sources.title: China’s Sea Goddess Has a New Job: AI Weather Forecasting
sources.title_en: China's Sea Goddess Has a New Job: AI Weather Forecasting

stories.summary_en: China handed over equipment for a customized MAZU AI weather prediction tool to Sri Lanka, where it will form part of a warning system for heavy rain, strong winds and cyclones, expected to enter service by year end. In Djibouti, the model helps provide tailored weather warnings for the port.
stories.title: China's Sea Goddess Has a New Job: AI Weather Forecasting
stories.value_added: Provides customized AI weather prediction supporting heavy rain, strong wind and cyclone warnings, and tailored port warnings in Djibouti.

sources.title_en: UChicago receives $10M grant to build open-source AI weather forecasting platform

stories.summary_en: The University of Chicago's Human-Centered Weather Forecasts initiative sent AI-based forecasts by text message to tens of millions of farmers in Africa and South Asia from 2024 to 2026. The forecasts correctly predicted an unusual stall in seasonal rains, giving farmers early warning. The article also reports a $10M grant to build an open-source AI weather forecasting platform.
stories.title: UChicago receives $10M grant to build open-source AI weather forecasting platform
stories.value_added: AI forecasts delivered by text message to tens of millions of farmers gave early warning of an unusual stall in seasonal rains.

sources.title: Vaisala Xweather unveils Met-in-a-box, bringing world-class AI weather forecasting to every corner of the globe
sources.title_en: Vaisala Xweather unveils Met-in-a-box, bringing world-class AI weather forecasting to every corner of the globe

stories.summary_en: Vaisala Xweather has unveiled Met-in-a-box, a compact AI weather forecasting system aimed at national meteorological services, governments and enterprises. The system requires no supercomputer and is said to run forecasts 40,000 times faster than traditional numerical prediction. It is positioned to make AI-based forecasting accessible to NMHSs worldwide.
stories.title: Vaisala Xweather unveils Met-in-a-box, bringing world-class AI weather forecasting to every corner of the globe
stories.value_added: Runs forecasts 40,000 times faster than traditional numerical prediction without requiring a supercomputer.

sources.title: Scientists just broke through a major barrier in weather forecasting
sources.title_en: Scientists just broke through a major barrier in weather forecasting

stories.summary_en: Scientists developed an AI-based post-processing method that improves weather forecasts three to four weeks ahead, giving earlier warnings of extreme weather. The method was tested on three forecasting systems, including ECMWF's models. The value added is extended forecast lead time for extreme weather warning.
stories.title: Scientists just broke through a major barrier in weather forecasting
stories.value_added: Improves weather forecasts three to four weeks ahead, offering earlier warnings of extreme weather.

sources.title: Hail, no: CSU taps AI to stretch ice storm forecasts by hours and days
sources.title_en: Hail, no: CSU taps AI to stretch ice storm forecasts by hours and days

stories.summary_en: Colorado State University's team combined an NVIDIA-based model, Hail-StormScope, with a CSU machine-learning model to forecast ice and hail storms. The system is reported to already increase warning times and update impact areas as storms evolve, offering longer lead times for hazard warnings in the United States.
stories.title: Hail, no: CSU taps AI to stretch ice storm forecasts by hours and days
stories.value_added: Increases warning times and updates impact areas as storms change, for ice and hail storm forecasts.

sources.title: To better predict destructive hail, these scientists are turning to AI
sources.title_en: To better predict destructive hail, these scientists are turning to AI

stories.summary_en: Scientists in Colorado and Wyoming, funded by the US National Science Foundation, are using AI to predict destructive hailstorms. The research targets longer warning lead times than the typical 30 minutes offered by current hail warning systems.
stories.title: To better predict destructive hail, these scientists are turning to AI
stories.value_added: Aims to improve prediction of destructive hailstorms beyond the roughly 30-minute warning lead time of current systems.

sources.title: From observations to forecasts: bringing AI-DOP into real time
sources.title_en: From observations to forecasts: bringing AI-DOP into real time

stories.summary_en: ECMWF is moving its AI-DOP system into real-time operation, generating forecasts directly from observations rather than from a traditional atmospheric analysis. The demonstration shows the approach can capture significant weather events, pointing to a simpler forecasting workflow.
stories.title: From observations to forecasts: bringing AI-DOP into real time
stories.value_added: Produces forecasts directly from observations without relying on an atmospheric analysis, and can capture significant weather events.

sources.title: BSC Leads European–Latin American AI and Supercomputing Initiative
sources.title_en: BSC Leads European–Latin American AI and Supercomputing Initiative

stories.summary_en: The Barcelona Supercomputing Center leads a European–Latin American initiative under the EU Global Gateway Strategy to develop efficient AI applications, language models for Latin American Spanish and Brazilian Portuguese, high-resolution earthquake and tsunami simulation, and studies on climate change impacts on coffee production. The AI work touches on disaster risk and climate impact assessment, though operational weather or early warning use is not explicitly stated.
stories.title: BSC Leads European–Latin American AI and Supercomputing Initiative
stories.value_added: Efficient AI applications with lower carbon footprint and water consumption, and high-resolution earthquake and tsunami simulation.

sources.title: AI models for extreme weather forecasts built - Chinadaily.com.cn
sources.title_en: AI models for extreme weather forecasts built - Chinadaily.com.cn

stories.summary_en: China has unveiled two AI models for extreme weather forecasting built on Fengyun satellite data. One targets short-term warnings of severe convective weather, predicting its occurrence, development and intensity four hours ahead.
stories.title: AI models for extreme weather forecasts built - Chinadaily.com.cn
stories.value_added: Predicts occurrence, development and intensity of severe convective weather four hours in advance using Fengyun satellite data.
